lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six vertical columns posterior to the visible branchial slits, with blob diameter increasing posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the primary blobs, forming a visible grid-like pattern in the mid-lateral flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature on the upper flank characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient, with illumination on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal teleost fish (remoras) trailing and attached to the ventral-lateral region posterior to the gills.
